name: 4C-PVP
summary: 4-Chloro-α-pyrrolidinovalerophenone is an emerging recreational designer drug of the pyrrolidinophenone class, similar in structure to α-pyrrolidinopentiophenone (α-PVP). The pharmacology and toxicity of this compound is unknown, though it is presumed to be a stimulant drug.

uses.text: 4-Chloro-α-pyrrolidinovalerophenone (also known as 4-chloro-α-pyrrolidinopentiophenone, 4-chloro-α-PVP, 4Cl-PVP, or 4C-PVP) is an emerging recreational designer drug of the pyrrolidinophenone class, similar in structure to α-pyrrolidinopentiophenone (α-PVP).

pharmacology.en: Its pharmacology has not been studied. Like α-PVP, it is presumed to block the reuptake of dopamine and noradrenaline.
pharmacology.zh: 它的藥理作用尚未被研究。一般推測它和α-PVP一樣，會阻斷多巴胺與正腎上腺素的回收。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它的药理作用尚未被研究。一般推测它和α-PVP一样，会阻断多巴胺与正肾上腺素的回收。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its family, the α-pyrrolidinophenones such as α-PVP, can cause a racing heart, raised blood pressure, overheating, insomnia, agitation, paranoia and a strong urge to keep redosing. Serious risks include psychosis, violent agitation, heart problems, seizures and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同家族的α-吡咯烷苯酮類藥物（例如α-PVP），可能引起心跳急促、血壓升高、體溫過高、失眠、躁動、多疑，以及想一再追加用藥的強烈衝動。嚴重風險包括精神病、激烈躁動、心臟問題、癲癇發作與成癮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同家族的α-吡咯烷苯酮类药物（例如α-PVP），可能引起心跳急促、血压升高、体温过高、失眠、躁动、多疑，以及想一再追加用药的强烈冲动。严重风险包括精神病、激烈躁动、心脏问题、癫痫发作与成瘾。

fact.en: It is α-PVP with a chlorine atom on the benzene ring. Its parent α-PVP became notorious in Florida around 2015 under the street name flakka.
fact.zh: 它是在α-PVP的苯環上加了一個氯原子。它的母體α-PVP在2015年前後以街頭名稱「flakka」在美國佛羅里達州聲名狼藉。
fact.zhHans: 它是在α-PVP的苯环上加了一个氯原子。它的母体α-PVP在2015年前后以街头名称「flakka」在美国佛罗里达州声名狼藉。
